title: Stop scrolling listings every night. Let the deals find you.
blurb: DealCaddie underwrites every listing in your market, pins each with its cash flow, and emails new matches every morning.

scenes.line: Finding a cash-flowing rental the old way? Scroll listings every night.
Then run the rent, taxes, insurance and comps on every single one.
By the time you find a good one, it's under contract.

do.eval: (async()=>{const L=await (await fetch('/api/buy-boxes',{credentials:'same-origin'})).json();const bs=(L||[]).filter(b=>/cleveland/i.test(JSON.stringify(b.markets||'')+' '+(b.name||'')+' '+(b.region_label||'')));if(!bs.length)return 'NO CLEVELAND BOX: '+(L||[]).map(b=>b.id+':'+b.name).join(', ');const b=bs[bs.length-1];const j=await (await fetch('/api/buy-boxes/'+b.id+'/map',{credentials:'same-origin'})).json();const rs=(j.rows||[]).filter(r=>r.lat!=null);const good=rs.filter(r=>/analyzed|passed|below_criteria/.test(r.screen_status||''));const use=good.length>=3?good:rs;const med=a=>{a=a.slice().sort((x,y)=>x-y);return a[a.length>>1]};if(use.length)localStorage.setItem('dc_deals_view_'+b.id,JSON.stringify({lat:med(use.map(r=>r.lat)),lng:med(use.map(r=>r.lng)),z:13,t:Date.now()}));localStorage.setItem('dc_deals_drawer','peek');localStorage.setItem('dc_pin_mode','cf');window.__cleBox=b.id;sessionStorage.setItem('cleBox',b.id);return 'box '+b.id+' '+b.name+' rows '+rs.length+' good '+good.length})()
